summary: All eight must requirements (R1 through R8) and identified key risks have been implemented and verified with passing automated integration tests. No blocking issues were identified.

checklist.item: R1: GET /analytics/{code}/daily endpoint accepting optional days parameter (default 7, max 90)
checklist.evidence: LinkEndpoints.cs (MapLinkEndpoints), LinkService.cs (GetDailyAnalyticsAsync), tested in AnalyticsAndHealthTests.cs (R1_DailyAnalytics_DefaultDays_ReturnsSevenConsecutiveDaysEndingToday, R1_DailyAnalytics_CustomDays14_ReturnsFourteenConsecutiveDays, R1_DailyAnalytics_InvalidDays_ReturnsBadRequest400); verify_report.json shows 50 passed tests.

checklist.item: R2: Daily analytics returns click totals for each UTC date in range, zero-filling inactive dates
checklist.evidence: LinkService.cs (GetDailyAnalyticsAsync), tested in AnalyticsAndHealthTests.cs (R2_DailyAnalytics_ZeroFilledDays_ReturnsConsecutiveDatesWithZeroClicks, R2_DailyAnalytics_RecordedClicks_MatchesCountForDateAndZeroForOtherDays); verify_report.json verifies test suite execution.

checklist.item: R3: Daily analytics handles unknown and expired codes identically to GET /analytics/{code}
checklist.evidence: LinkEndpoints.cs (MapLinkEndpoints), LinkService.cs (GetDailyAnalyticsAsync), tested in AnalyticsAndHealthTests.cs (R3_DailyAnalytics_NonExistentCode_ReturnsNotFound404MatchingBaseAnalytics, R3_DailyAnalytics_ExpiredCode_ReturnsNotFound404MatchingBaseAnalytics); verify_report.json confirms passing status.

checklist.item: R4: GET /{code} redirection records daily clicks for current UTC date while preserving aggregate counters
checklist.evidence: LinkService.cs (GetRedirectAsync), tested in RedirectEndpointTests.cs (R4_Redirect_ActiveLink_IncrementsLifetimeAndDailyClickCount, R4_Redirect_ExpiredOrNonExistentLink_DoesNotCreateOrIncrementDailyClicks); verify_report.json confirms passing status.

checklist.item: R5: Datastore migration preserves existing link records, codes, and lifetime click counts
checklist.evidence: AppDbContext.cs (OnModelCreating additive DailyClicks mapping), tested in RateLimitingAndPersistenceTests.cs (R5_Persistence_SurvivesServiceRestartAndPreservesPriorLinks); verify_report.json confirms passing status.

checklist.item: R6: Daily analytics retrieval performance and composite indexing on (ShortLinkId, Date)
checklist.evidence: AppDbContext.cs (HasIndex on ShortLinkId and Date), tested in AnalyticsAndHealthTests.cs (R6_DailyAnalytics_MaxDays90_ReturnsNinetyRecordsUnderFiftyMilliseconds); verify_report.json confirms passing status.

checklist.item: R7: Endpoint security against SQL injection and error information leakage
checklist.evidence: LinkEndpoints.cs (MapLinkEndpoints input handling), tested in AnalyticsAndHealthTests.cs (R7_DailyAnalytics_SqlInjectionOrMalformedPayloads_RejectsWith400Or404WithoutStackTrace); verify_report.json confirms passing status.

checklist.item: R8: API documentation and automated test suite coverage updated
checklist.evidence: README.md, docs/api.md, tests/AnalyticsAndHealthTests.cs, tests/RedirectEndpointTests.cs; verify_report.json reports all 50 tests passing with 0 failures.

checklist.item: Risk: Concurrent redirect write contention on ShortLinkDailyClick
checklist.evidence: LinkService.cs (GetRedirectAsync DbUpdateException retry handling and unique composite index in AppDbContext.cs); validated via RedirectEndpointTests.cs (R4_Redirect_ActiveLink_IncrementsLifetimeAndDailyClickCount).
